messages:
rachel: kicking off a gated bring-up for rwd-v6-tokenized-int4 (new tokenizer + int4 tuning). plan: preflight smoke -> micro-shadow 25m -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%. posting proposed gate config for feedback.

devin: love the plan. couple asks: 1) compare MRR and LONGFORM_MRR vs anchored baseline not live-prod (to avoid noise). 2) require min_samples per slice and a min_total_samples per step.

mira: add longform (LF-MRR), rerank (RERANK-MRR), and shortchat slices. longform traffic sparse so set eval_window longer + higher min samples. also we should guard tokens/sec since tokenizer change can alter throughput.

rachel: agreed. here's a console-ready snippet we can paste to the rollout UI (will run preflight smoke before micro-shadow):
```
rollout_id: RL-20260327-01
model: rwd-v6-tokenized-int4
sequence:
  - preflight_smoke: {enabled: true, queries: 1500}
  - micro_shadow: {duration: 00:25:00}
  - steps:
      - percent: 1
        duration: 00:15:00
        require_concurrent_failures: true
      - percent: 5
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 20
        duration: 01:20:00
auto_fallback:
  warnings:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 0.6
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      threshold_pp: 0.2
  hard_fail:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 1.7
    - metric: LONGFORM_MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 2.2
    - metric: LATENCY_P95
      comparator: absolute_increase_ms
      threshold_ms: 40
    - metric: TOKENS_PER_SEC
      comparator: relative_decrease
      threshold_pct: 20
slices:
  - name: longform
    metric: LONGFORM_MRR
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 40m
  - name: rerank
    metric: RERANK_MRR
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 15m
  - name: shortchat
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 2000
    eval_window: 10m
general:
  min_samples_per_step: 2500
  require_concurrent_failures_for_small_steps: true
  small_step_threshold_pct: 1
  preflight_smoke_queries: 1500
  stability_window: 10m
```

devin: small-step concurrence is important. require two metrics (MRR + either HALLUC_PP or TOKENS_PER_SEC) to trigger auto-rollback at the 1% step. single-metric hard-fail allowed for >=5% steps.

mira: also add a min-sample floor per slice in the console so slices with <min_samples are marked as "insufficient data" and don't count towards rollback decisions. and longform needs a 40m eval window.

canary-bot: RL-20260327-01 created in staging. manual start pending. Runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/tokenizer-quant-gates (permissions required).

sre-oncall: tagging @sre-oncall for 3h watch. I'll monitor preempt/oom, queue depth, and tokens/s per worker. escalation if queue depth > 400 or tokens/sec drop > 15% sustained > 5m.

rachel: action items: 1) mira export slice defs + enable min-sample enforcement (ETA 25m). 2) devin wire the #canary-eyeballs warning webhook + #sre-watch hard-fail webhook (ETA 20m). 3) rachel will run preflight smoke and post results then kick micro-shadow (ETA 50m). if any hard_fail triggers we auto-rollback and file a short blameless postmortem. :rocket:
